<thought>The mass spectrum shows a clear M+1 peak (~13% of base) consistent with multiple 13C atoms, indicating carbon is present. It also shows an M+2 peak at ~33% of the base intensity, matching the characteristic chlorine isotopic pattern (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 75.8%/24.2%). No other element shows a distinctive pattern of this magnitude. Therefore, the definitively identifiable elements are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
